title: Brazilian-Style Fried Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and filling dish inspired by the streets of Brazil, featuring crispy fried rice, earthy vegetables, and a hint of Brazilian spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of frying oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for an additional 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and sauté until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of frying oil over medium heat.
Add the cooked Brazilian rice and stir-fry until lightly browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked vegetables to the rice and stir-fry until well combined.
Season with cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Brazilian-style fried rice bowl hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
